== Published English Original Virtual Set 1 wording ==
The released unnumbered, numbered and Premium slips all grant the piloting bonus of 4, ship immunity below 5 and once-per-battle destiny subtraction of 3 (twice with a Black Squadron pilot). The 2006 text uses a during-battle trigger and explicitly allows cumulative subtraction. The destiny reduction, the Black Squadron condition and Vader’s own attrition threshold remain. Doug Taylor’s February preview gives the starship an attrition threshold below 4. All released early slips instead say below 5 for the starship. The preview is a distinct pre-release source.
